Explorer fixtures

inventory.json defines 29 owned objects per cluster, including the kubesift-explorer namespace and widgets.explorer.kubesift.dev CRD. scripts/dev-clusters.sh --explorer checks collisions before applying to kind-dev-local-a/b only. It never replaces shop/billing or creates clusters.

BusyBox 1.37.0 is pinned to sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec. Heartbeats occur every 30 seconds. missing-image, missing-setting, failed-job and pending-storage are intentional failures; CronJob is suspended. Secrets are fake. A/B same-pod markers are local-a and local-b. Broader fixtures do not imply product browsing coverage.

Phase 1C.2 adds init-evidence (completed init container), web-lookalike (Deployment label match without controller ownership), and scaled-zero (zero desired replicas).

The pod-reader ServiceAccount can only get/list Pods in this namespace. Short-lived token kubeconfigs belong in ignored .local storage, never here.

Phase 1C.3b uses the existing web Ingress, web and stateful Services, generated EndpointSlices and allow-fixture-network policy on both clusters. The Ingress has no controller. These fixtures exercise configuration and reference identity; they supply no traffic or enforcement evidence. The restricted pod-reader identity is reused without expanding its permissions.

Phase 1C.3c uses phase-1c3c.yaml in the separate kubesift-config-check namespace on approved kind contexts. It owns synthetic policy, configuration, Pod references and a ConfigMap-only reader. The Secret contains synthetic sentinels. Remove the owned namespace after verification and leave the existing explorer namespaces in place.

phase-1c3d.yaml creates the isolated kubesift-storage-check namespace, a nondefault StorageClass, one Retain PV, Bound and Pending claims, a scheduling-gated Pod, and a PVC-only test identity. Check the namespace, class and volume names for collisions before creation. Delete only these owned objects after verification; never force finalizers or create the host path.
